gui: GUIs are the main part of the framework and the entry point for every pane and inventory. Create a GUI with new ChestGui(rows, title). Rows must be between 1 and 6. Update the GUI after changes with gui.update(). Show it with gui.show(player).
panes: Panes are sub-regions inside a GUI. Types: OutlinePane (fills border/area), StaticPane (bind items to exact slots), PaginatedPane (pages of items), PatternPane (uses a character pattern), MasonryPane (items fill left-to-right, top-to-bottom). Each pane has x, y, length (width in slots), height (rows).
outline_pane: OutlinePane fills either the border or the entire area specified by (x, y, length, height). Use addItem(GuiItem) to place items. Items are placed starting from the top-left going right, wrapping to the next row.
static_pane: StaticPane places items at exact slots. Use bindItem(slotX, slotY, GuiItem). slotX is 0-based column (0-8), slotY is 0-based row. Useful for buttons at fixed positions.
paginated_pane: PaginatedPane splits items into pages. Navigation items (next/previous page) can be added. Set the page with setPage(int).
pattern_pane: PatternPane uses a 2D character pattern to decide where items go. Each character maps to an item.
gui_item: GuiItem wraps an ItemStack with a click action. Create with new GuiItem(ItemStack) or new GuiItem(ItemStack, event -> {}). You can also use ItemStackBuilder: new ItemStackBuilder(Material).setDisplayName("Name").setLore(Arrays.asList("Line1")).build().
xml: GUIs and panes can be loaded from XML files. Example: <gui rows="5" title="Shop"><outlinepane x="0" y="0" length="9" height="5"><item id="diamond"/></outlinepane></gui>. Load with ChestGui.load(this, inputStream).
slot: A slot is one inventory cell. Chest GUIs have 9 columns. Row count is passed to the constructor (1-6). Total slots = rows * 9.
components: IF provides pre-built components: Label, ToggleButton, CycleButton, PercentageBar, Slider, PagingButtons. These are special panes/items that provide interactive behavior.
